Hi Emma / Ava,

Thanks for the request and the SOW — reviewed the Nimbus_DPA_v1 you attached. A few high-level notes after an initial pass of Redwood's master DPA:

1) Transfers / SCCs
- We are prepared to adopt the EU Commission SCCs for controller-processor flows. We will include the executed SCCs as an Addendum (or incorporate the SCC text into the contract where your counsel prefers).

2) Subprocessors / Annex A
- We will provide Annex A listing subprocessors and the region of processing. For any subprocessors located in countries outside the EEA, we can provide a short security profile describing the safeguards in place.

3) Retention & audit traces
- Our standard retention table will be included as a Schedule; we can provide sample audit extracts under an NDA if Nimbus wants to spot-check.

4) Redlines & execution method
- We have three small redlines that typically come up: liability cap alignment, security incident notice timing (24 vs 72 hours), and the indemnity carveouts for open-source components. I will mark these in the attached redline (summary below) and can fast-track a clean copy if Nimbus accepts those points.
- Regarding signing: we prefer DocuSign for our standard workflow. If Nimbus insists on AdobeSign, legal ops needs to confirm signatory workflow and identity verification. Both are acceptable but DocuSign shortens turnaround.

Proposed timeline:
- Today: Laura sends redline summary (this email) + updated DPA with tracked changes.
- Tomorrow (EOD): Ava to confirm commercial milestone dates for insertion into SOW.
- Friday: Target to send final clean DPA for signature.

If you want a quick call to walk through the redlines, I'm available 11:00–12:00 PT today.

Redline summary (high level):
- Liability: keep combined cap at twice monthly recurring charges; Nimbus asked for 6 months MRC — we propose EoM discussion.
- Incident notification: accept 24-hour preliminary notice with full report within 72 hours.
- Subprocessor termination: add 30 days notice for material subprocessor changes.

I'll attach the tracked DPA now.

Laura Bennett
Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
